builds.name: Savage Killer
builds.desc: This build aims to maximize damage dealt on player phase to leave enemies severely weakened on enemy phase to the extent that her unique weapon ability can take enemies out before they can touch her. Doubling down on Savage Blow makes her more effective against hoards of weaker enemies while doubling down on Poison Strike gives effectiveness against a single more powerful enemy. In either case her biggest weakness will be enemies with Distant Counter that can kill her on player phase. Try to weaken these enemies by utilising Savage Blow and attacking near by enemies that can't counter attack. Pairing her with Duma running Upheaval is also advised.
